content.comment_body: Hello, I'm trying to set up a system where the on and off times for one output change in a complex sequence. For testing, we need timing like: 120 seconds on, 2 seconds off, 150 seconds on, 10 seconds off, 90 seconds on, 12 seconds off, 100 seconds on, 170 seconds off. Each timer should control a single output. Is this achievable, and how would I go about it? Any advice would be appreciated! Best regards, [user_name]
Hello, Yes, you can use an OR gate between your timer and the output.

Thanks for your response, but I was referring to a setup where four timers run one after another in sequence. For example, first timer 1 (with, say, 150 seconds on and 10 seconds off), then timer 2 (100 seconds on and 20 seconds off), and so on, with all connected to a single output (Q1). With an OR gate, the zero state won’t be transferred. Thanks again!
Try this solution to see if it meets your needs.
